_rationale: California per-state profile (graduated 1–13.3%) with the round-3 fix that lets the state std deduction ($5,540) absorb into LTCG when ordinary income is below the deduction. With $0 ordinary, the stacked walk runs CA single brackets over (w − $5,540): 1%·10,412 + 2%·14,272 + 4%·14,275 + 6%·15,122 + 8%·1,545.5 ≈ $1,992. Solving 50,000 = w − 0.15w − stateLTCG(w) iteratively → w ≈ $61,167. Federal LTCG = $9,175; State LTCG = $1,992 (vs. $2,481 before std-ded absorption, vs. $5,195 under the original flat-8% model). Balance year 1 = 1,000,000 − 61,167 = $938,833.
